scope: GET /videos/:id/upload only; no other new video endpoint, worker or domain-service change.

implementation.handler: CurrentUser.sub + ParseUUIDPipe id delegate to existing VideoUploadsService.resume; global JWT required, no client upload id authority or business logic in controller.
implementation.response: 200 video safe projection and upload parts {partNumber,sizeBytes,etag}; typed response DTO reuses session fields and documents array/item schemas.
implementation.documentation: Compiled OpenAPI exported and validated: UUID path, Bearer security, 200 response with inherited session fields and nested parts, all expected error envelopes. Prior POST creation operation unchanged; all committed API operations preserved.
implementation.rate_limit: 120/min with real inherited throttler; creation stays 10/min. Both use new central VIDEO_HTTP_RATE_LIMITS constants.
implementation.real_partial_upload: Part 1 is 67108864 bytes streamed directly to MinIO from a reused 64KiB buffer; part 2 remains absent. GET parts match real S3 size/ETag, replays preserve id/slug/session/expiry and zero outbox.
implementation.security_and_state: Other owner/no channel/absent resource 404; missing/invalid JWT401; invalid UUID400; expired missing source410; completed expired source409; processing/ready409. Query does not mutate session, video or outbox.
implementation.media_fixtures: Processing uses a real completed small MP4 through existing completion service. Ready state is seeded explicitly with real MP4/JPEG objects and matching metadata; it does not pretend that a worker ran. Auxiliary fixture tracks and cleans derivative objects on suite close.
